descriptionHtml:
Onikuma DM01 Tri-Mode Ultra-Lightweight Wireless RGB White Gaming Mouse with Custom Sticker

Experience the pinnacle of competitive velocity and cable-free tracking agility with the Onikuma DM01 Tri-Mode Ultra-Lightweight Wireless RGB White Gaming Mouse. Available at Turbo Computer, this professional PC hardware peripheral is masterfully engineered for elite esports players, pro FPS gamers, and high-speed digital store managers across Egypt who demand swift execution speeds, zero hand resistance, and cross-platform flexibility. Weighing an astonishingly light 57 grams and paired with a premium custom mouse grip sticker inside the box to maximize your hand stability, this mouse guarantees flawless control and prevents palm slippage during intense gaming sessions.

The Onikuma DM01 is packed with premium internal architecture, powered by a high-precision Instar S205 optical sensor and a robust Furikun FR2012B MCU core to unlock 12,800 DPI processing channels with 120 IPS acceleration and a responsive 7200 FPS frame rate layout. It features a versatile Tri-Mode connection scheme running a lag-free 1000Hz polling rate via 2.4GHz wireless and wired Type-C lines, alongside a power-saving Bluetooth mode for on-the-go productivity tracking. Armed with a built-in 500mAh rechargeable battery, it juices up fully in just 4 hours to deliver up to 50 extensive hours of continuous execution gameplay. Complete with dynamic RGB multi-zone illumination lines, 6 programmable buttons, and an official 1-year warranty, this sleek white gaming layout is the ultimate hardware upgrade for modern desktop setups.
